howToPlay: Angelo is a marksman who excels at long-range combat. Use Stinging Flight for mobility and emergency escapes, or utilize Master Fletcher to hit targets behind cover. Combine the healing from Empower with water movement boosts from Flow to sustain yourself on the battlefield.
gears: Damage is essential for increasing pressure as a marksman. Shield adds survivability given the low base health of 3100, while Gadget Cooldown is highly recommended to use Stinging Flight more frequently.
trait: This brawler suits players who prefer long-range precision and tactical positioning.
